body:
## Bug

`ScheduleHandle.Describe()` returns a `ScheduleWorkflowAction` with a zero-value `Priority` field, even when the schedule was created with priority/fairness settings.

## Root cause

`scheduleActionFromProto` in `internal/internal_schedule_client.go` builds the `ScheduleWorkflowAction` struct but omits `Priority`. `convertFromPBPriority` already exists — it just isn't called here.

## Fix

```go
Priority: convertFromPBPriority(workflow.GetPriority()),
```

Happy to open a PR with the fix.

comments.body: Opening a PR with the fix would be great! Thanks for finding this 😀

title: fix: schedule describe does not populate Priority on ScheduleWorkflowAction
